chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch.10: Eastmarsh Swamp – Ji Ning Saves the Ironstone Tribe
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning leaves Western Prefecture for Eastmarsh Swamp. On the way, he rescues a small tribe from a Huan Beast and gains a guide for the treacherous swamplands ahead.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch.10: Eastmarsh Swamp – A Divine Arrow Turns the Tide
og_description: On the journey to his first real trial, Ji Ning saves a hunting party with a perfect long-range kill and earns a guide into the dangerous Eastmarsh Swamp.
twitter_description: Ji Ning's adventure begins! He leaves home, saves a tribe, and hires a veteran guide to the deadly Swamp.
